Our Partners

Every WellRed meetup happens at a local South Florida business. These are the ones who have hosted us so far. We're dedicated to introducing our readers to more local spots and encouraging everyone to shop local.

October
Coming up October 24 ✦

South Florida Sewing Studio

A sewing school and community space in Fort Lauderdale. They teach everything from beginner sewing to pattern making and swimwear design.

They're hosting our October meetup, a crochet class where everyone makes their own bookmark, plus book talk on Carmilla.

Meetup details Visit the studio
September
September 26 ✦

Amelia's

An independent cafe and bookstore in Fort Lauderdale, formerly Pulp & Press. They do craft coffee, breakfast, all-day brunch and lunch, with shelves of books to browse.

We met there on September 26 to talk Fruit Fly by Josh Silver over coffee and do a craft.

Visit Amelia's
August
August 29, our first meetup ✦

Alivia Ryan Salon Co.

A small business salon in Plantation, and the host of our very first meetup on August 29. We talked My Brilliant Friend over drinks and mocktails, made bookmarks with watercolor pens, offered permanent jewelry, and the salon threw in a discount and a giveaway for everyone who came.

Twenty members showed up, a full room, and a night we're still talking about.

Visit Alivia Ryan Salon Co.
